commits.title: fix(agent): enforce query tool policy and validate red-team boundaries
commits.body:
Purpose
Consolidate the previously implemented local safety baseline after 477ac3b.
The model could propose a registered tool outside the active query allowlist;
the disclosure evaluator checked only the numerically next customer identifier.

Changes
Apply query-scoped least-agency policy before dispatch and HITL. Preserve the
untrusted RAG/tool-output labels, deterministic identity controls and output guard.
Recognize explicit Spanish claim imperatives without bypassing approval. Reuse
the canonical foreign-customer detector in the evaluator and add regression cases.
Include the pending Phase-2 harnesses, invariant checks and historical evidence
with explicit limits on UTPR, live reproducibility and semantic false positives.

Validation
On 2026-09-22, .venv/Scripts/python.exe -B scripts/quality_gate.py --fast:
13 PASS gates; 466 tests passed and 11 Redis-dependent tests skipped inside them.
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q ai/agent/tests/e2e: 11 passed in 2.18s.
The dispatch/disclosure regressions were demonstrated failing before their fixes
on 2026-09-21. No tests were weakened to bypass approval or ownership controls.

Limitations
R2 remains partial; no new live Foundry run or cloud execution. The 75 Pyright
diagnostics recorded on 2026-09-21 remain pending. This is not release approval.
The following documentation commit records the combined validated checkout.

commits.title: docs(application): add maintained navigation for humans and LLMs
commits.body:
Purpose
Make the application understandable by responsibility and location, with clear
reading paths for newcomers and LLMs and a repeatable documentation maintenance loop.

Changes
Add onboarding, folder-level READMEs, directory ownership maps and evolution rules.
Extend the stdlib documentation generator with curated llms-full.txt and folder
inventory while preserving README.LLM.md, llms.txt and JSON navigation. Reject
private/outside sources and test deterministic generation. Explain Git separation,
side effects of maintenance commands, historical evidence and current release limits.
Correct the RAG adapter contradiction, preserve accepted ADRs and historical reports,
and ignore virtualenv variants, local MLflow, smoke state and graph caches.
Document researched llms.txt, Diataxis, Write the Docs and Git ignore conventions.
Require reviewed commit titles and detailed purpose/change/validation/limits bodies.

Validation
python -B scripts/test_documentation_index.py: 9 passed.
python -B scripts/documentation_index.py --write followed by --check: PASS;
repeat generation is byte-stable and local file links resolve. Ruff and git diff
--check pass. Full FAST and E2E results for the combined baseline are recorded in
docs/quality/NAVIGATION-20260922.md; skipped Redis tests are explicitly disclosed.

Limitations
The expanded context is a curated reading bundle, not a dump of all code/data.
LLM clients are not assumed to auto-load it. Link checks do not validate anchors,
remote URLs or all Markdown dialects. No new banking capability or release;
Pyright remediation, R2 acceptance and isolated Docker/remote CI remain pending.
